fullDescription: A meticulous 1-bit retro OS design system recreating the aesthetic of early monochrome desktop environments (Mac OS Classic, early Windows). Featuring a dithered 50% checkerboard background, crisp pixel-perfect line art, and high-contrast black and white UI surfaces. Optimized for SaaS dashboards, vintage-themed web applications, and brutalist design projects. Highlights include a warm dark-grey bezel frame (#282725), striped title bars, inverted selection states, and period-correct 1-bit form controls without shadows, blurs, or gradients.

structured.summary: A retro 1-bit monochrome desktop OS interface characterized by dithered backgrounds, pixelated typography, and sharp 1px black borders on pure white surfaces. The layout uses a centered window approach with a two-pane interior, mimicking system preferences modules from the late 80s/early 90s.

style.description: Strict monochrome 1-bit aesthetic using only black (#000000) and white (#FFFFFF) for the UI, wrapped in a dark warm-grey bezel (#282725). Typography uses monospaced bitmap-style fonts for OS chrome and clean sans-serif for content. Textures are created via 4px dithered checkerboard patterns rather than grey fills. All borders are exactly 1px solid black.
style.prompt:
Create a UI style inspired by 1-bit operating systems. 
- **Colors**: Core palette is #FFFFFF (backgrounds) and #000000 (text/borders). Frame the viewport in a 16px border of #282725 with 8px rounded corners. Use #f37725 and #3685c5 sparingly for status indicators and links only.
- **Typography**: OS chrome and labels in 'Courier Prime' or 'Chicago' (14-15px, 0.02em tracking, no anti-aliasing). Content text in 'Verdana' or 'Geneva' (15px, 1.5 line-height). Section heads at 20px bold.
- **Borders & Corners**: 1px solid black borders for all elements. 8px border-radius for windows, 4px for buttons and checkboxes, 0px for layout containers.
- **Textures**: Use a 4x4 pixel dithered checkerboard (alternating black and white pixels) for background fills and scrollbar troughs. 
- **Effects**: No shadows, no gradients, no transparency. Active states are handled via color inversion (white text on black background).

layout_and_structure.description: A fixed 100vh layout consisting of a physical-style bezel frame, a top utility menu bar, and a desktop area containing floating windows and an icon rail. Navigation is split between a static left sidebar and a scrollable right content pane.

prompts.prompt: Wrap the entire 100vh/100vw viewport in a 16px thick border of #282725. The outer corners should have an 8px radius to simulate a CRT monitor housing. The interface inside is perfectly rectangular.

Fixed at the top, a 32px high white bar with a 1px bottom black border. Left-aligned: system logo (line-art glyph) and text links (File, Edit, View, Special) in bold bitmap font. Right-aligned: three 14px status dots in #f37725, #3685c5, and #000000.

Fill the space behind windows with a repeating 4x4px dithered checkerboard pattern of black and white. Right-edge: A vertical column of desktop icons (32x32 line art) with 1px bordered white caption boxes below each icon.

Centred window at 62% width, white background, 8px radius, 1px black border. Title bar: 32px high with 6 horizontal 1px black stripes running edge-to-edge. A square 'close' box on the left and the window title centered in a white box that interrupts the stripes. Include an 'inactive' window peeking behind, offset by 24px, with no title bar stripes and faded text.

Split the window into a 96px left category rail and a flexible right pane. Divide with a 1px vertical black line. The left rail contains vertical icon/label pairs. Active categories use the 'inverted' style (black background, white content). The right pane is the only scrolling region on the screen.

A 48px bottom bar inside the window. Left: a 'disclosure' triangle with 'Advanced' label. Right: Action buttons (Revert, Save) with 4px radius. The primary 'Save' button must have a 'double border' (2px white gap between two black borders) to denote default action.

special_ui_components.description: A classic OS window header texture.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a title bar background using a linear-gradient pattern of horizontal 1px lines. Pattern: 1px black, 2px white, repeating every 3px for a total of 13px height. Ensure the window title text has a solid white background to clear the stripes.

Checkboxes: 20x20px square with 1px border, tick mark is a pixelated poly-shape. Radio: 16x16px circle with a solid 8x8px inner dot when selected. Stepper: A text box paired with two stacked 24x12px square buttons containing solid triangle glyphs. Slider: 1px horizontal black line with a 16x16px square white handle.

A 20px wide scrollbar. Trough: 4px dithered pattern. Thumb: 18px wide white rectangle with a 1px black border. Buttons: 20px square boxes at top and bottom with 1px borders and solid black triangle arrows. No rounded ends.

structured.special_notes: Must not use any anti-aliasing for the 'bitmap' font. Must not use any shades of grey except for the bezel #282725. Must ensure the scrollbar thumb is a simple white rectangle with 1px border, while the trough is the 4px dithered pattern. Interaction must be binary: hover states should only use subtle black/5% overlays or inversion.
